attributes.provenance: Derived on src/game/enemy/critter.c::CritterDamagePlayer (run 51, lane CR), the SOLE anomaly the census finds, and whose whole residual is this order: target `lwz r0,68(r1) / lmw r28,40(r1) / lfd f31,56(r1) / mtlr r0 / addi r1,r1,64 / blr` against ours `lwz r0,68(r1) / lfd f31,56(r1) / lmw r28,40(r1) / addi r1,r1,64 / mtlr r0 / blr`, over a byte-identical prologue (`stfd f31,56(r1)` then `stmw r28,40(r1)`), frame 64 and save set f31+r28-r31 in both streams. The census was written because the sibling functions CritterGetTarget and CritterReCalcTarget in the SAME TU emit the target's shape from our own compiler, which refuted the compiler-variant reading before any probe was spent. Companion record: attempt.CR_critterdamageplayer-the-whole-residual-is-the-epilogue-restore-order-and-three-source-classes-fold.20260904.v1.
attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family; applies to any function whose epilogue restores an inline `lfd` FPR AND an `lmw` GPR block. subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: MWCC's epilogue RESTORE ORDER for a function that restores both an inline `lfd` FPR and an `lmw` GPR block is CONTEXTUAL, not a fixed property of the compiler or of the frame, and our build already reproduces the retail choice everywhere but ONE function image-wide -- so an epilogue-order residual is a single-function anomaly to be explained, never evidence of a compiler-version or flag difference. MEASURED IMAGE-WIDE, both streams, zero builds, by `python tools/gdl/composed_census/cr_epilogue_census.py` (3232 of our functions parsed, 3032 target): the population restoring both is 109 ours / 110 target and splits FOUR ways. Ours: LMW_FIRST/ADDI_FIRST 87, LMW_FIRST/MTLR_FIRST 13, LFD_FIRST/ADDI_FIRST 8, LFD_FIRST/no-mtlr-addi-pair 1. Target: 88 / 14 / 7 / 1. THE TWO LFD_FIRST SETS ALL BUT COINCIDE -- ours 9, target 8, EIGHT in both (AddLocatorInstList, DrawGlowText, PlayVQMovie, draw_power_meter, fn_8005C1DC, fn_8006E654, get_actual_screen_pos, shop_setup), TARGET-ONLY none, and OURS-ONLY exactly one: CritterDamagePlayer. Both orders therefore occur in BOTH streams, the choice is context-derived, and our compiler makes retail's choice on 108 of 109. NEGATIVE HALF, equally measured: the obvious determinants do NOT explain it. Cross-tabulating by saved-GPR count, inline-restored-FPR count, whether the FPR save slot sits ABOVE the GPR block, and the FPR register number separates nothing -- at CritterDamagePlayer's exact configuration (4 saved GPRs, 1 inline FPR, FPR slot above the GPR block, f31) the target is LMW_FIRST 14 of 14 and LFD_FIRST zero, while ours is LMW_FIRST 13 and LFD_FIRST 1. The determinant is real, reproduced 108 times, and still unidentified. CONSEQUENCE for a matching lane: an epilogue-order diff is NOT a licence to reach for a compiler variant, a cflags change or a peephole pragma -- run this census first, and treat a function in the residue as a per-function anomaly whose cause is upstream of the epilogue, since the prologue, frame and save set can be byte-identical while the epilogue differs (CritterDamagePlayer's are).
